sentence: This project builds and studies human stem cell models and rodent models of conditions that affect how the nervous system works.
This project builds a data framework that combines data from many studies to understand temporomandibular disorders and identify their subtypes.
This project tests whether too much of one protein causes vascular endothelial dysfunction that leads to heart damage, using a rodent model.
This project uses CRISPR to convert human white adipocytes grown in culture into beige adipocytes and tests them in humanized mice.
This project builds human cochlear organoids to study what causes hearing loss and to test possible treatments.
This project tests whether ion channel proteins at the tips of microvilli sense mechanical signals on the surface of epithelial cells.
This project studies the structures and functions of synaptic vesicle proteins to understand how they work in neurotransmission and epilepsy.
This project tries to find out how lung function changes after tuberculosis treatment and how to spot patients at risk of lung disease.
This project develops a blood test that complements mammography for early detection of breast cancer, using mass spectrometry on plasma.
This project tries to understand how immune T cells respond to food in health and in celiac disease.
This project develops wavelet biomarkers to detect brain injury in babies asphyxiated at birth.
This project engineers beta cells with immune checkpoint ligands so transplanted cells avoid rejection in type 1 diabetes.
This project studies outcomes of people who have both cancer and COVID-19, including outcomes that may not show for years.
This project tests an immunocompetent mouse model of dedifferentiated liposarcoma for studying immunotherapies.
This project studies how pararubulavirus envelope proteins trigger fusion and uses genome-wide CRISPR screening to find host receptors for viral entry.
This project uses biophysical and biochemical techniques to study the structure and function of a transient receptor potential channel found in the skin.
This project tests how amyloid precursor protein and regulator of calcineurin1 affect sleep disturbances in Down syndrome.
This project builds a tool that uses digital breast tomosynthesis to assess long-term breast cancer risk in Black women.
This project studies how Plasmodium malariae malaria parasites are transmitted by investigating the parasites and vectors at a study site.
This project uses electrophysiology and voltage imaging to study how signals from subcortical brain regions reach the frontal cortex through the thalamus.
